"];
const merciContactShadows=MERCI_CONTACT_SHADOWS.map(src=>{const im=new Image(); im.src=src; return im;});
// Completed Merci stage #3 is 285 source px wide. The 2x2 floor base
// should almost fill 2*TILE (84 world px), while the topper projects above.
const MERCI_THEATER_SOURCE_WIDTH=285;
function merciStageForAssembly(progress){return Math.min(3,Math.floor(clamp(progress,0,1)*4));}
function merciStageForDismantling(progress){return progress>0?4+Math.min(3,Math.floor(clamp(progress,0,1)*4)):3;}
function drawMerciTheater(x,y,stage=3,alpha=1){
const image=merciTheaterFrames[clamp(stage|0,0,7)];
if(!image||!image.complete||!image.naturalWidth){
ctx.fillStyle='#bf2028';ctx.fillRect(x*TILE+3,y*TILE+3,2*TILE-6,2*TILE-6);
ctx.fillStyle='#fff1dd';ctx.font='bold 13px sans-serif';ctx.textAlign='center';
ctx.fillText('merci',(x+1)*TILE,(y+1)*TILE+5);
return;
}
// Match the completed display to its 2x2 foundation; all eight frames
// share this scale so assembly and dismantling never pulse in size.
const scale=(TILE*2-2)/MERCI_THEATER_SOURCE_WIDTH;
const w=image.naturalWidth*scale,h=image.naturalHeight*scale;
const px=(x+1)*TILE-w/2;
const py=(y+2)*TILE-h-2;
ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha*=alpha;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
// Pixel-aligned ground contact, following the bottom footprint of this frame.
// The old wide, detached ellipse made the construction appear to hover.
const contact=merciContactShadows[clamp(stage|0,0,7)];
if(contact&&contact.complete&&contact.naturalWidth){
ctx.drawImage(contact,px,py,contact.naturalWidth*scale,contact.naturalHeight*scale);
}
ctx.drawImage(image,px,py,w,h);
ctx.restore();
}
